newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker supported by pre-Christmas demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker supported by pre-Christmas demand.

text.p: Singapore bunkers indications were firm on Thursday with pre-Christmas buying still supporting prices, traders said.

"We expect prices to remain supported until early next week," said a major. Majors were quoting 180-cst at $130-$132 per tonne with independents at $127-$128. Bunker 380-cst were quoted at $127-$128 per tonne by majors and $124-$126 by independents.
But some sellers remained on the sidelines, waiting for clearer direction from the cargo market.
MDO and gas oil were at $238-$245, $255-$263 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
